headlines.title: Price of parenting: the household maths giving China’s consumers pause
headlines.summary:
Qiu Huiying, a human resources manager in Guangdong, worries in numerical terms when she looks ahead to the next decade: a 20-year mortgage, a 10 per cent loss on her property and thousands of yuan in monthly childcare costs that are set to rise.

headlines.title_en: Eight departments including MIIT launch special action on innovation policy support for tech enterprises
headlines.summary_en: The 'Special Action' focuses on the evaluation and certification of high-tech enterprises by promoting data sharing, optimizing service systems, and strengthening information verification to enhance work efficiency. The Ministry of Industry and Information Technology has established a coordination mechanism for innovation policy support for tech enterprises to address bottlenecks. High-tech enterprise certification management bodies lead the efforts, with relevant departments from industry, technology, finance, emergency management, taxation, market regulation, and intellectual property collaborating to form a cohesive force.

headlines.title_en: ChiNext surges over 3% with volume; CXMT turnover exceeds 140 billion yuan for full day
headlines.summary_en: 1, Overall trend: Markets oscillated upward throughout the day, with all three major indexes rising. Stocks broadly rallied, with about 5200 stocks in Beijing, Shanghai, and Shenzhen turning red, and total turnover at 2.09 trillion yuan. Computing hardware stocks rallied with International Composites, Honghe Technology, and Hongban Technology hitting limit-up. Battery chain strengthened with Shengyang Supercapacitors, Longpan Technology, and Wanli Shares hitting limit-up.

headlines.title: 上半年中非贸易成绩亮眼 外交部：今年贸易总额有望再上新台阶
headlines.summary: 【上半年中非贸易成绩亮眼 外交部：今年贸易总额有望再上新台阶】林剑表示，今年上半年中非贸易亮点纷呈。一是总量加速跃升，中非的进出口商品总额达到1.41万亿元人民币，为历史同期最高，今年的贸易总额有望再上新台阶。二是结构持续优化。据统计，中国对非出口75%是资本品和中间品，主要是满足非方工业化和农业现代化需要的生产性资料，非消费资本。三是非洲对华出口的潜力不断释放，对非洲建交国全面实施零关税举措以后的五、六两个月，中国自非进口1938亿元人民币，同比增长了23.5%。

headlines.title_en: H1 China-Africa trade achieves impressive results; Foreign Ministry: total trade expected to reach new high this year
headlines.summary_en: First-half China-Africa trade showed impressive results. Spokesperson Lin Jian noted that total imports and exports reached 1.41 trillion yuan, a historic high for the period, with annual trade expected to hit new highs. Structure improved, with 75% of China's exports to Africa being capital and intermediate goods for industrial and agricultural modernization. Africa's export potential to China is growing; in May and June following the zero-tariff policy for African diplomatic partners, China's imports from Africa hit 193.8 billion yuan, up 23.5% year-on-year.

headlines.title: 光伏行业成本核算团体标准正式发布
headlines.summary: 日前，在国家市场监督管理总局、工业和信息化部指导下，由中国光伏行业协会牵头编制的团体标准《光伏行业成本核算模型通则》正式发布。本标准以企业会计准则为基础，通过统一“硅料—硅片—电池—组件”全产业链的成本计算范围、计算系数和计算模型，形成贯通产业链的成本核算框架，可破除行业内成本核算口径不一、各自表述的乱象。这是落实党中央、国务院关于规范市场竞争秩序、推动高质量发展部署的具体举措，也是光伏行业管理从自律倡议走向制度化、标准化的重要一步。

headlines.title_en: Group standard for cost accounting in photovoltaic industry officially released
headlines.summary_en: Recently, under the guidance of the State Administration for Market Regulation and the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, the group standard 'General Principles for Photovoltaic Industry Cost Accounting Models' was officially released by the China Photovoltaic Industry Association. Based on corporate accounting standards, this standard unifies cost calculation scope, coefficients, and models across the 'polysilicon-wafer-cell-module' full chain, forming a comprehensive cost framework. It aims to eliminate industry inconsistencies. This is a concrete measure to implement central and State Council plans for market order and high-quality development, marking the photovoltaic industry's step from self-regulation to institutionalization and standardization.

headlines.title: 大行评级丨小摩：维持宁德时代“增持”评级，仍是中国电池价值链中首选
headlines.summary: 摩根大通发表报告指，宁德时代第二季纯利225亿元，处于市场预期220至230亿元的中间水平；上半年纯利同比增长42%，表现稳健。管理层在业绩会上重申，对2027年电池需求维持高度信心，预期增长可能超越长期20%至30%的复合年增长率。该行维持对宁德时代“增持”评级，H股目标价725港元，基于30倍2026年预测市盈率，仍是中国电池价值链中的首选。意料之外的A股回购计划，将提振投资者信心。

headlines.title_en: Major rating: JPMorgan maintains 'Overweight' on CATL, remains top pick in China's battery value chain
headlines.summary_en: JPMorgan reported that CATL's Q2 net profit of 22.5 billion yuan is in the middle of the market expectation range of 22-23 billion yuan; H1 net profit grew 42% year-on-year, showing stable performance. Management reaffirmed high confidence in 2027 battery demand, predicting growth may exceed the long-term 20-30% CAGR. JPMorgan maintains an 'overweight' rating on CATL with an H-share target of 725 Hong Kong dollars, based on 30x 2026 PE, as a top pick in China's battery value chain. An unexpected A-share buyback plan will boost investor confidence.

headlines.title_en: Production ramp-up in southwest China; July-August domestic polysilicon output to increase significantly
headlines.summary_en: Over the weekend, polysilicon N-type re-feeding material quotes were 30.8-33 yuan/kg, overall stable. Due to meetings and policies late last week, some manufacturers slightly raised quotes. July domestic polysilicon production is expected to increase significantly, mainly from Southwest region ramp-ups, but current domestic output is around 100,000 tons, below earlier expectations. August production is expected to continue rising. Inventories saw a slight increase; with fewer recent signings as prior orders execute, polysilicon company inventories are hard to deplete, leading to a rise. (Shanghai Nonferrous Metals)
